title: Rate Manual: Term Life Insurance Installment After a Face Decrease
content:
**Term Life Insurance.** The installment after the face decrease is the installment premium on record less the installment share of the premium the decrease releases.

### Quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Current face | the face amount on record |
| Requested face | the new face amount of the approved face decrease request |
| Policy years completed | the whole years from the issue date to today |
| Permanent face counted toward the band | nothing, so each band measurement face is the face itself |
| Band factor at each face | 1.00 |
| Face premium at each face | that face divided by 1,000, times the rate per 1,000 on record, times its band factor, rounded to the cent |
| Fee before sharing at each face | the product's annual policy fee |
| Policy fee share in the released premium | the whole fee |

### The released premium

The premium the decrease releases is the face premium at the current face less the face premium at the requested face, plus the fee before sharing at the current face less the fee before sharing at the requested face times the policy fee share, rounded to the cent. The long-standing fee concession and every rider charge are unchanged by a decrease and release nothing.

The installment share of the released premium is the released premium times the modal factor of the premium mode on record (the product's quarterly factor for quarterly, monthly bank-draft factor for monthly bank draft, semiannual factor for semiannual and annual factor for annual), rounded to the cent. The installment after the face decrease is the installment premium on record less that installment share, rounded to the cent.

### Components a decrease leaves in the installment on record

Each stays in the installment on record as it stands, whatever figures it reflects, and none of it is released:

- the long-standing fee concession (10.00 after 20 completed policy years, 5.00 after 10);
- the accidental death charge, whatever rate per 1,000 it reflects (1.08 at anniversary ages 60 through 69, that is 60 or more and below 70; 0.84 below 45; the product's rate otherwise);
- the children's term charge, whatever unit rate it reflects (5.00 at 11 or more units, 5.50 at 5 through 10, the product's rate below 5);
- the waiver charge, whatever rate it reflects (0.14 at issue age 45 or more, 0.11 at 35 through 44, 0.09 below 35) and whatever base (by issue age 40 or more, 30 through 39, below 30).

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Ashgrove Level Term 20 in quarterly mode; current face 600000; requested face 400000; rate per 1,000 on record 1.50; installment premium on record 300.00.

- Face premium at the current face: 600 times 1.50 times 1.00, which is 900.00; at the requested face: 400 times 1.50 times 1.00, which is 600.00.
- Fee difference: the product's annual policy fee at both faces, so nothing.
- Released premium: 300.00. Installment share: 300.00 times 0.265, which is 79.50.
- Installment after the face decrease: 300.00 less 79.50, which is 220.50.
